items.summary:
Fleet product review: do not add new proposals or queue work this cycle. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, 39 improvements await measurement, 21 requests failed, approved-proposal execution is 64%, and only 6 outcomes are proven. Preserve the existing saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case, then run the already-queued allthingsmasonic.com CTA experiment after capacity and overlap clearance.

Highest-leverage capabilities, to prioritize after capacity clears: (1) canonical queue reconciliation and deduplication across scheduler, task board, and executive control plane; target fewer duplicate handoffs and higher approved-work execution. (2) A measurement-debt workflow that automatically advances, closes, or escalates deployed improvements and failed requests using existing telemetry only; target reducing the 39 pending measurements and 21 failed requests. (3) Restore the existing read-only operations evidence path for deploy, uptime, errors, and fleet-doctor results; preserve unknowns until evidence exists. (4) Standardize owner/role fallback routing where human-triage or content roles are unavailable, with explicit handoff and rollback records. (5) Expand AI-usage coverage only through an approved implementation path; current evidence covers 4 sites and must not be generalized.

Prioritization: control-plane reconciliation first for operator time saved and reversibility; measurement debt second for reliability and measurable outcomes; operations evidence third for safety; routing fourth for adoption; AI-cost coverage fifth for cost accountability. No new telemetry, schedule changes, access grants, deployments, or production mutations are recommended. Keep private launch and security-sensitive gates unchanged.
